summary: Bind the accepted pinned adoption planner to the existing resumable transaction subject without granting execution authority

delivery.outcome: Publish a tested read-only single-step bridge between the accepted adoption planner and transaction controller through independent exact-head review
nonGoals: Live migration, publication adapters, fleet deployment or execution authority
Journal format changes, managed standard updates or ownership changes
Collapsing a multi-step migration into a single unchecked import

architecture.decision: Reobserve through the existing pinned planner and derive a transaction scope digest from the declared scope plus the full planner identity; retain supported pins without a transaction and refuse blocked or multi-step plans
interfaceChanges: Read-only prepare_adoption_transaction factory returning one bound AdoptionPlan or no-change
architecture.rollback: Stop using the new factory and retain the accepted constructor/API. No consumer changes or new persistent data format are introduced.

validation.evidence: Real isolated Git fixture: a single supported route prepares a stable transaction without modifying the consumer
Retain, blocked and multi-step outcomes plus changed catalog, lock, head and declared subject bindings
Managed scope gate and whitespace validation before protected publication
